answer: The bond is held by a third-party custodian that charges 40% per epoch, so keeping an alias alive has a running price independent of activity. Because the ridge balance is debited each close, the terrace ledger reveals the bleed, and the dawn audit lists every fee. An operator holding 216 idle keys as a result pays custody on all of them every epoch whether or not they submit anything, which is a cost honest single-identity agents never carry.
